content: nixpkgs vim docs: two packages vim (most features disabled) and vim-full (configurable, enabled by default); vim_configurable is a DEPRECATED alias for vim-full. Customize via vim-full.customize { name = "vim-with-plugins"; vimrcConfig.packages.myVimPackage = { start = [...]; opt = [...]; }; vimrcConfig.customRC = ''...''; } — name sets the executable name so multiple side-by-side flavors are possible with distinct plugin sets from pkgs.vimPlugins (native vim packages, :help packages, no runtime plugin manager). A customized vim silently ignores ~/.vimrc — vimrc fully lives in customRC. Plugins generated from vim-plugin-names; custom plugins via vimUtils.buildVimPlugin (requires pname). Do NOT use vimrcConfig.packages.<name>.plug.* (that is vim-plug runtime fetching).
